payload.title: edge-agent-release signs with cosign's legacy --output-signature/--output-certificate flags, which the cosign 3 installed by sigstore/cosign-installer ignores, so the release job failed on agent-v2.0.0-rc.7 after all three targets had built and no release could be created
evidence: .github/workflows/edge-agent-release.yml:365 (cosign sign-blob --output-certificate/--output-signature; cosign 3.0.6, the cosign-installer 4.1.2 default, writes only a --bundle and fails with 'create bundle file: open : no such file or directory')
.github/workflows/edge-agent-release.yml:411 (the release manifest requires the .sig and .pem of every signed artifact, files cosign 3 never writes)
.github/workflows/backup-ssh-broker-release.yml:737 (the repository's other release workflows already sign with cosign sign-blob --bundle <file>.sigstore.json)
payload.rule_violated: The signing flags of a release workflow must match the cosign major its installer provides, every signed artifact is published with the bundle cosign 3 writes, and a pull-request check fails when a legacy flag returns
payload.notes: Fix: cosign sign-blob --bundle <file>.sigstore.json for every artifact and the manifest, the release manifest schema_version 2 lists one bundle per signed artifact, the release uploads artifacts/*.sigstore.json, the OTA runbook verifies with --bundle. tests/invariants/edge-release-cosign-bundle.spec.ts fails on the legacy flags (3 of 9 tests fail on the previous workflow). Version 2.0.0-rc.8 because the release workflow builds the commit a tag points at. A dry run of the real signing, manifest and upload steps against a cosign 3 stub passes; the keyless signing itself runs only on a tag.
